items.sourceHeading: MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS- DUAL ENERGY X-RAY ABSORPTIOMETRY (DXA)
items.requirement: A room size of 15-20 square meters may be required, depending on the design of the equipment. If limited space is available, 10 square metres may suffice for a compact pencil beam DXA system.
items.alternatives: 10 square metres may suffice for a compact pencil beam DXA system where limited space is available

measurement.expected: 15-20 square meters depending on equipment design; 10 square metres may suffice for a compact pencil beam DXA system

items.sourceHeading: MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS- DUAL ENERGY X-RAY ABSORPTIOMETRY (DXA)
items.requirement: A protective shield for the operator's console.
